name: Chemlite Innovation Berhad
overview: 2026年，Chemlite Innovation Berhad 未公告新的业务扩张、收缩或合约。公司主要企业行动为设立长期激励计划（含员工认股权计划与股份授予计划），并宣派2026财年中期股息。最新一季（2026年6月30日）营收同比增5.5%，净利润同比降36.9%。
overview_en: In 2026, Chemlite Innovation Berhad did not announce any new business expansion, contraction, or contracts. Its main corporate actions were the establishment of a long-term incentive plan (comprising an employees' share option scheme and a share grant scheme) and the declaration of an interim dividend for FY2026. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 5.5% year-on-year while net profit fell 36.9% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及长期激励计划及中期股息，未披露各业务板块的具体动态。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly relate to the long-term incentive plan and interim dividend, with no specific segment-level updates disclosed.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE FOLLOWING:- (I) PROPOSED ESTABLISHMENT OF A LONG-TERM INCENTIVE PLAN COMPRISING AN EMPLOYEES' SH
actions.text: 包含员工认股权计划及股份授予计划，合计不超过已发行股份总数（不含库存股）的10.0%。
actions.text_en: Proposed establishment of a long-term incentive plan comprising an employees' share option scheme and a share grant scheme, of up to 10.0% of the total number of issued shares (excluding treasury shares, if any).

actions.title: CLITE - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派2026财年中期单层股息每股RM0.0035，除权日为2026年5月12日，派发日为2026年5月26日。
actions.text_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of RM0.0035 per ordinary share for FY2026, with ex-date 12 May 2026 and payment date 26 May 2026.
